title: #454 Bilingual Education
prompt: What is your opinion on the necessity of bilingual education in a globalized world?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Bilingual education helps people connect with others by giving them skills to talk to people from different places.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Bilingual education helps people connect with others by giving them skills to talk to people from different places.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Bilingual education gives good opportunities for work because knowing more than one language makes people useful in many countries.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Bilingual education gives good opportunities for work because knowing more than one language makes people useful in many countries.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Focusing too much on language learning can make other school subjects difficult.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Focusing too much on language learning can make other school subjects difficult.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Students need to focus on important subjects first.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Students need to focus on important subjects first.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Bilingual education provides significant career advantages by improving job prospects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Bilingual education provides significant career advantages by improving job prospects.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Learning a second language enhances cultural understanding and promotes global empathy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning a second language enhances cultural understanding and promotes global empathy.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary argument against mandatory bilingual education is that it can distract students from mastering core academic subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary argument against mandatory bilingual education is that it can distract students from mastering core academic subjects.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second argument is that general education provides universal knowledge that is more valuable than specialized language training.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second argument is that general education provides universal knowledge that is more valuable than specialized language training.
